basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a student at UBC, currently in my second year of a Bachelor's in Arts with a focus on History. I'm originally from Calgary, but I've been loving the vibrant city life in Vancouver. I have a keen interest in pop culture, especially anything related to Netflix and reality TV. In my free time, I enjoy watching musicals and collecting unique belt buckles from various places. I'm usually online in the evenings, typically after my classes and part-time job at a local café. I'm single and enjoy connecting with people who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is primarily centered around pop culture and history. I've gained a lot of insights from my coursework at UBC and my passion for watching documentaries and reading historical novels. I'm also self-taught in identifying unique fashion accessories, particularly belt buckles.
